entries.title: Cloud Architecture & Azure
entries.description: Azure migration and infrastructure modernization, hybrid connectivity, and cloud resource analysis, with operational continuity as a practical priority.

entries.title: SQL Server & Data Platforms
entries.description: Database availability, operational investigation, and data-platform support. The project stories distinguish platform engineering from report development and analysis from completed remediation.

entries.title: Cybersecurity & Identity
entries.description: Identity and application-access troubleshooting, cloud security review, and evidence preparation for compliance work.

entries.title: Infrastructure & Networking
entries.description: Hybrid connectivity, private cloud-service access, and infrastructure transition work, considered alongside backup and recovery requirements.

entries.title: Automation & FinOps
entries.description: Reusable cost-reporting and inventory automation that connects subscription spending, project allocation, resource tagging, and commitment reviews with practical financial decisions.

entries.title: AI-Assisted IT Operations
entries.description: Human-reviewed use of agents and runbooks for evidence gathering, technical investigation, and reporting. Experimental integrations remain distinct from production controls.

entries.title: IT Leadership & Governance
entries.description: Connecting technical teams, cloud-cost visibility, license reviews, and documented evidence with business priorities and clear approval boundaries.
